statements.quote: Total HPC hosting revenue was $24.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to nil for the same period in the prior year due to the initiation of HPC hosting operations at our Austin, Texas data center during the quarter ended June 30, 2024.
statements.notes: HPC data-center hosting revenue (seller side); the filing ties HPC hosting to machine learning and AI demand elsewhere (p03), but this sentence does not say AI explicitly. Includes pass-through power costs.

statements.quote: As of December 31, 2024, the Company was contractually committed for approximately $1.14 billion of capital expenditures, primarily related to infrastructure modifications, equipment procurement, and labor associated with the conversion of a significant portion of its data centers to deliver hosting services for HPC.
statements.notes: Contractually committed capex expected to occur over the next year (per the following sentence), so recorded as an outlook with no year named in the sentence. Scope is total because the commitment is 'primarily' rather than wholly for HPC conversion. HPC is AI-linked only by context. $899.3 million of it is reimbursable by the customer.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses to AI; HPC hosting cost descriptions (p09, p12) do not state an AI amount or share
